subject: math
cluster: Solve real-life and mathematical problems involving angle measure, area, surface area, and volume
intro: Use one angle relationship in each problem. Complementary angles add to $90^\circ$, supplementary angles (a straight line) add to $180^\circ$, vertical angles are equal, and angles around a point add to $360^\circ$. Each problem takes a single step.

items.prompt: Two angles are complementary. One angle measures $34^\circ$. Find the measure of the other angle $x$.
Two angles are complementary. One angle measures $61^\circ$. Find the measure of the other angle $x$.
Two angles are supplementary. One angle measures $115^\circ$. Find the measure of the other angle $x$.
Angles $\angle ABD$ and $\angle DBC$ form a straight line (a linear pair). If $\angle ABD = 72^\circ$, find $\angle DBC = x$.

steps: Angles on a straight line are supplementary, so $x + 72 = 180$.

items.prompt: Two lines intersect. One angle measures $70^\circ$. Find the measure of its vertical angle $x$.
Two lines intersect. One angle measures $128^\circ$. Find the measure of its vertical angle $x$.
Two angles are complementary. One angle measures $45^\circ$. Find the measure of the other angle $x$.
Two angles are supplementary. One angle measures $90^\circ$. Find the measure of the other angle $x$.
Ray $BD$ lies inside right angle $\angle ABC$, splitting it into two adjacent angles. If $\angle ABD = 38^\circ$, find $\angle DBC = x$.

steps: The two adjacent angles compose a right angle, so they add to $90^\circ$: $x + 38 = 90$.

items.prompt: Two angles are supplementary. One angle measures $43^\circ$. Find the measure of the other angle $x$.
Two angles are complementary. One angle measures $18^\circ$. Find the measure of the other angle $x$.
Two lines intersect. One angle measures $95^\circ$. Find the measure of its vertical angle $x$.
Three angles meet at a point and together make a full turn. Two of them measure $150^\circ$ and $130^\circ$. Find the third angle $x$.

steps: Angles around a point add to $360^\circ$, so $x + 150 + 130 = 360$.

items.prompt: Angles $\angle PQS$ and $\angle SQR$ form a straight line (a linear pair). If $\angle PQS = 24^\circ$, find $\angle SQR = x$.

steps: Angles on a straight line are supplementary, so $x + 24 = 180$.

items.prompt: Ray $BD$ lies inside right angle $\angle ABC$, splitting it into two adjacent angles. If $\angle DBC = 27^\circ$, find $\angle ABD = x$.

steps: The two adjacent angles compose a right angle, so they add to $90^\circ$: $x + 27 = 90$.
